title: Zeus Grime Wipes
description:
Description
This Kit Includes
Conveniently clean components of your vaporizer with Zeus Grime Wipes. Each Grime Wipe contains ethyl alcohol and is individually packaged for optimal freshness and performance providing a hassle-free maintenance solution for your vaporizer components made of metal, glass and ceramic. This pack of 25 grime wipes works in seamless combination with the Zeus Purify multi-purpose cleaning solution and Zeus Bristle Pipe Cleaners for regular care and maintenance of your unit.
25x ethyl alcohol soaked wipes.
